remarks: Tucked just steps away from downtown New Canaan, this charming 3 BR/2.5 bath town home offers the perfect blend of comfortable living, modern amenities, and a prime location. The sun drenched eat-in kitchen features premium finishes and appliances, as well as ample storage. The living room boasts beautiful custom built-ins, a gas fireplace, hardwood floors and french doors leading to a private fenced-in patio. This seamless layout also includes a cozy home office/den with built-ins. The sizable primary suite has a walk-in closet and updated bathroom. Two spacious bedrooms and a laundry complete the 2nd Floor. The lower level provides an additional 600 square feet of finished living space! Ideal for a recreation room or family room. This unit has an attached garage with 3 additional designated parking spots. In town living at its best!!!
